name: Run interactive tabletop role-playing game sessions
description: Users asked the AI to act as a game master or dungeon master to facilitate interactive role-playing game sessions, often within tabletop RPG rulesets like D&D or LANCER. They also requested the design of specific campaigns, adventures, character sheets, and narrative scenarios for various fantasy, sci-fi, and horror settings.
